subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice, with the symbols $, @, !, *, ∞, ÷, are shown. Find the symbol on the face opposite the face showing '÷'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/651629c7361e8013c647b9f324e30421679fb0d8e565b6bcf25800f612bd93fb.png]
solution:
From the given two dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/902047c1d7633283d75f12a45ad468acaef4b5e81d90b00bb28cc1208b7218a1.png] 

→ $ and ! are common surface in both Dice, therefore, '*' is the opposite surface of '÷'.

Here, '*' is opposite to the face containing '÷'.

Hence, the correct answer is "*****".
